jeffan.note: The site refits a common score from per-benchmark evidence; it does not copy the source leaderboard rank. Forty-two public subtasks are submitted evidence from one source, not forty-two independent reruns. The original public submission supplies a checkpoint whose weights and engine files match the catalogue snapshot. The exported private leaderboard record still does not pin its execution revision.

original_submission.state: closed, not merged; no issue comments returned
original_submission.public_run_protocol: BF16, vLLM 0.29.0, one question at a time, a second read when the leading probability is below 0.9. The submission pins the checkpoint and engine.
original_submission.interpretation: The exact public-submission checkpoint exists. Its weight shards, config, tokenizer and engine Python files have identical repository blob identifiers to the catalogue snapshot. Documentation, licences and package metadata differ; this is artifact-level identity evidence, not a reproduced runtime result. The unpinned private leaderboard execution is not independently reconstructed.

correction.before: Labelled as open weights because the repository contains model.safetensors.
correction.after: Explicit rule-based engine; open_weights false; access.kind code. The file contains 527 hand-set constants and is 10,320 bytes, not learned model weights.

limitations: No model inference was run; accessible files and valid sample tensor headers establish published artifacts, not reproduced capability.
The wider metadata audit establishes repository/document availability; it does not independently reproduce each checkpoint, historical recipe, model authorship or training claim.
Some catalogue entries are evaluated inference recipes or rule-based engines rather than independently trained models; 357 entries must not be described as 357 unique trained neural networks.
Existing independent-evidence gaps remain. Jeffan has only one independent evaluator source; a leading fitted score does not establish broad consensus.
Gated model metadata can be public while weight access still requires acceptance or approval.
Fresh numeric comparison covers Decision Index text/vision exports; other sources were not all numerically re-imported in this identity review.
